data.title: Speeding fine notice: €98.50 and 1 point
data.summary: The Central Fines Office (Zentrale Bußgeldstelle Musterland) issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) dated 16 September 2025 for driving 23 km/h over the limit on the A 49 on 27 August 2025. The total is €98.50 and 1 point in the driving register.
data.explanation: You are accused of exceeding the 70 km/h limit by 23 km/h. The fine is €70.00, plus €25.00 fees and €3.50 expenses. The letter was formally delivered on 19 September 2025. You may decide to file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or record it at the fines office; the app shows the deadline. If you don't object in time, the notice becomes final and can be enforced. Payment is due within two weeks of the notice becoming final (Rechtskraft). If you're unsure whether to object, consider getting legal advice.
